description:
A Niederlassungsleitung user's Quotations list only shows quotations
  belonging to their own Niederlassung (branch), regardless of what other
  branches' quotations exist in the system. This is deliberately end-to-end
  (real login, real list view) rather than a duplicate of the existing
  ORM-level unit tests covering the same scoping rule.

elements.name: Niederlassungsleitung's quotations list excludes other branches

steps.name: the standard IFMS test data exists
I am logged in as "admin" with password "admin"
a test customer "NLSCOPE Test Kunde" with default payment terms "30 Tage netto" exists
a quotation named "NLSCOPE-WIEN" exists for customer "NLSCOPE Test Kunde" with branch "Niederlassung Wien"
a quotation named "NLSCOPE-STMK" exists for customer "NLSCOPE Test Kunde" with branch "Niederlassung Steiermark"
quotation "NLSCOPE-WIEN" has payment terms "30 Tage netto" taken over from the customer
I am logged in as a "Niederlassungsleiter"
I navigate to Quotations
I remove the "Meine Angebote" filter
the quotations list shows "NLSCOPE-WIEN"
the quotations list does not show "NLSCOPE-STMK"

name: Access Rights — Niederlassungsleitung sees only their own branch

description:
A contact person filed under a customer may keep their own postal address
  instead of the customer's. This is deliberately end-to-end rather than a
  duplicate of the ORM-level unit tests covering the same rules: Odoo hides
  the address block on a Kontakt and only the "Eigene Adresse verwenden"
  switch reveals it, which no Python test can observe, and the decoupling
  has to hold through a real form save — the address synchronisation runs on
  a write the form composes, not one a test hands it.

elements.name: The address fields appear in the contact dialog once the switch is on

steps.name: the standard IFMS test data exists

a customer "BDD Eigenadresse Kunde" with the street "Arsenalstraße 8" in "1030" "Wien" exists
a contact person "BDD Eigenadresse Kontakt" of "BDD Eigenadresse Kunde" exists
I open the contact person "BDD Eigenadresse Kontakt" from the Kontakte tab of "BDD Eigenadresse Kunde"
the contact dialog shows no address fields
I turn the "Eigene Adresse verwenden" switch on in the contact dialog
the contact dialog shows the address fields
